# the product contract is API compatibility (AGENTS.md "Backwards

# The plan's C-9 row names three examples. The extracted schema shows the real

# point, since a partial rename would be worse than none.
# [param_canonical] — the same ruling, one level down.
# [optional_config] — keys with no default, which therefore cannot be
# The extractor reads the shipped defaults document, so it can only see keys

# quietly smaller than the real surface — the typed layer reads them, so the
# schema must know them. Declared here, merged into the key set with no
# Each row binds one config key to the Rust field that carries it and the
# typed accessor that extracts it. THIS IS THE SOURCE from which

# extraction and this bead swaps in the generated form, so the config surface
